label: Night Out
description: A portrait taken where people actually go out — club floor, cocktail bar, rooftop, backstage. Venue light does the work: practicals, haze and colour rather than a key, so the frame reads as somewhere real rather than a set. The subject comes from human/profile, which already draws its own wardrobe and hair — this template deliberately adds neither, so the prompt never states two outfits.
prefix: A candid nightlife portrait of {subject}, {expression}, caught in the middle of a night out. {trigger}
suffix: Nightlife Rendering: (venue light only — practicals, LED wash and haze doing every bit of the modelling:1.25), colour allowed to go where the room puts it, (skin kept honest under coloured light:1.15), motion permitted at the frame edges, high ISO grain accepted rather than cleaned away, (sharp focal subject in a busy room:1.15).
negative: studio lighting, seamless backdrop, flat even light, watermark, text, logo, deformed, extra limbs, extra fingers, child, underage
